 %% ============ CANONICAL COLLECTION ============
 class ElementLR0 {
 -left
 -right : list
 -point : int
 +symbol_next_point()
 +point_at_the_end() bool
 +advance_the_point() ElementLR0
 +__eq__(other) bool
 +__hash__() int
 +__str__() str
 }

 class Canonical_Collection {
 -grammar
 -end_symbol_name : str
 -states : list
 -transitions : list
 -acceptation : set
 +closure(items) list
 +go_to(items, symbol) list
 +canonical_collection() list
 +_symbols_after_point(state) list
 +find_state(state) int
 +same_state(a, b) bool
 +show()
 }

 %% ============ FIRST / FOLLOW ============
 class FollowError {
 <<Exception>>
 }

 class Follow {
 -non_terminals : list
 -terminals : list
 -start_symbol
 -productions : dict
 -first_sets : dict
 -follow_sets : dict
 +from_grammar(grammar, first_sets)$ Follow
 +_validate()
 +_first_of_sequence(sequence) set
 +compute() dict
 +_sort(elements) list
 +format_sets() str
 }

 %% ============ FLEX LEXER ============
 class FlexError {
 <<RuntimeError>>
 }

 class FlexResult {
 <<dataclass>>
 +tokens : list
 +symbols : list
 +errors : list
 +log : str
 }

 class FlexRunner {
 -source : Path
 -build_dir : Path
 -executable : Path
 -ready : bool
 -compiled_source
 +_run(command, cwd, timeout) str
 +compile() str
 +analyze(code) FlexResult
 }

 %% ============ PYTHON LEXER ============
 class LexicalError {
 <<Exception>>
 }

 class TokenType {
 <<Enumeration>>
 PROGRAM
 VAR
 BEGIN
 END
 IDENTIFIER
 INTEGER_LITERAL
 REAL_LITERAL
 STRING
 ASSIGN
 PLUS
 MINUS
 EOF
 }

 class Token {
 <<dataclass>>
 +type : TokenType
 +value : str
 +line : int
 +column : int
 +__str__() str
 }

 class Variable {
 <<dataclass>>
 +name : str
 +line : int
 +__str__() str
 }

 class VariableTableBuilder {
 -variables : dict
 +build_from_tokens(tokens) dict
 }

 class Lexer {
 -text : str
 -position : int
 -line : int
 -column : int
 -errors : list
 +current_char() str
 +peek() str
 +advance()
 +skip_whitespace()
 +skip_comment()
 +read_identifier() Token
 +read_number() Token
 +read_string() Token
 +read_double_char_operator() Token
 +get_next_token() Token
 +tokenize() list
 }

 %% ============ GRAMMAR / PERSISTENCE ============
 class GrammarError {
 <<ValueError>>
 }

 class GrammarReader {
 -file_path
 +read() Grammar
 +from_text(text)$ Grammar
 }

 %% ============ MODELOS EXTERNOS ============
 class Grammar {
 <<external>>
 +productions : list
 +terminals : list
 +not_terminals : list
 +start_symbol
 +add_production()
 +add_terminal()
 +add_not_terminal()
 +get_production(symbol)
 }

 class Symbol {
 <<external>>
 +name : str
 +is_terminal : bool
 }

 class Production {
 <<external>>
 +left : Symbol
 +right : list
 }
